params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P1
Summary: A garage's 45 own photos of one vehicle stay "processing" on the photo tab: 0 of 45 ready, every tile grey with "processing takes longer than expected". The garage cannot use the vehicle's photos.

## What was reported

On 2026-11-25 (reported 10:58) a garage saw every own photo of one vehicle stuck on the photo tab ("Site web et petites annonces"): the progress line says 0 of 45 photos ready and every tile shows the "late" pill on a grey tile. The vehicle is not shared; these are the garage's own photos, not platform copies.

## What the screenshots tell

- Grey tiles with the processing pill are rows with `processing = 1` whose image does not load. An own upload (`ImageController::upload_dropzone`) writes its row with the tmp path (`<id>/drop/car_image_N.ext`), which is not in the bucket, so the tile is grey until `ProcessVehiclePhoto` writes the three sizes and sets the final path. A background removal on an existing photo would show the photo dimmed instead. So these are most likely uploads whose `ProcessVehiclePhoto` job has not finished.
- `ProcessVehiclePhoto` either finishes the row or, when it gives up, removes it (`failed()`, R S1-6.36). A row that stays in processing means the job did not run, or is still running, or was lost.

## Relation to yesterday's merges

- #1119 (`PhotoNames::free`) only names platform copies; this vehicle is not shared, so that code is not on this path.
- #1116 (`ProcessVehiclePhoto` releases a job after a refused write, 10 s then 60 s) is on this path, but a release puts the job back in the queue for at most 70 seconds and the third attempt still ends in the photo or in `failed()`. It cannot leave a row in processing by itself. Both deploys yesterday did restart the queue worker, so a worker that did not come back would show up exactly like this, for every garage.

## Needs

A production read: the rows of this vehicle (created, updated, handled), the `jobs` table by job and reserved state, `failed_jobs` of the last days, and whether other garages' uploads since yesterday are stuck too. Asked of the owner as a tinker script.

Source: Portal mail:68 (forwarded by the office, with screenshots).
params.title: A vehicle's own uploaded photos stay in processing: 0 of 45 ready
